title: mem20 5000QA question
description: One question in the 5000QA evaluation set. Stored as JSONL, one object per line.

question.description: The natural-language query sent to the MCP server

expected_answer.description: Reference answer. Empty string is allowed for expect_refusal questions.

evidence_ids.description: Record ids that must appear in the retrieved set

partition_probe.description: True if this question tests grounded/simulated separation

expect_refusal.description: True if the correct behaviour is to report absence rather than answer
